scope: Candidate correctness and migration only; no public syntax cutover, performance or AI accuracy claim. Native checking, when present, uses the recorded compiler-module artifact and portable host IR decoder. Archived experiment proofs remain independent controls.
method: All accepted source entries from the committed inventory; exact per-file IR/comments/imports/profiles and formatter fixed points; guarded whole-closure migration with staged shared validation and revision checks; optional A0 native parsed IR and typed facts. With --native-graph, original and migrated projects also use the shared graph policy with one native parse per source unit, direct IR composition and one native check; no TypeScript validation or full-source reparse on that route. Existing native output/spec proofs remain separate.
